items.title: MCP Inspector lets a web page run code on your machine
items.summary: The inspector proxy accepted unauthenticated requests, so a malicious website could reach it from the browser and execute commands on a developer workstation.

items.title: EchoLeak: zero-click prompt injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.summary: Crafted content in an email could steer Copilot into leaking data from the user’s context to an attacker, without the victim clicking anything.

items.title: Next.js middleware authorization bypass
items.summary: Sending an internal x-middleware-subrequest header made Next.js skip middleware entirely, bypassing auth checks implemented there.

items.title: Wormable Windows TCP/IP remote code execution over IPv6
items.summary: Specially crafted IPv6 packets could trigger an integer underflow in the TCP/IP stack and give an unauthenticated attacker code execution.

items.title: regreSSHion: unauthenticated RCE in OpenSSH server
items.summary: A signal handler race condition, a regression of a 2006 bug, can let a remote attacker run code as root on glibc-based Linux systems.

items.title: Go net/netip misclassifies IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses
items.summary: Methods like IsPrivate and IsLoopback returned wrong answers for IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses, which can break allow-lists and SSRF protections.

items.title: PHP-CGI argument injection on Windows
items.summary: Windows “Best-Fit” character conversion lets attackers smuggle command-line options into php-cgi and execute arbitrary PHP code.
items.kevAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

items.title: Backdoor hidden in xz / liblzma release tarballs
items.summary: Malicious code planted by a long-term maintainer hooked into sshd through systemd on some Linux distributions, enabling remote access for the attacker.

items.title: follow-redirects leaks Proxy-Authorization across domains
items.summary: The Proxy-Authorization header was kept when following a redirect to another host, exposing proxy credentials.

items.title: Leaky Vessels: container escape in runc
items.summary: A leaked file descriptor let a malicious image or build step reach the host filesystem and break out of the container.

items.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset denial of service
items.summary: Opening and instantly cancelling streams floods servers with work, enabling record-breaking DDoS attacks against HTTP/2 endpoints.
items.product: HTTP/2 servers · nginx, Go, Netty, Envoy…
items.kevAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

items.title: libwebp heap overflow exploited through images
items.summary: A malformed WebP image could overflow a heap buffer in the decoder, leading to code execution in anything that renders images.
items.kevAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

items.title: Log4Shell: JNDI lookup remote code execution
items.summary: Logging an attacker-controlled string could make Log4j fetch and run remote code via JNDI, one of the most exploited bugs ever.
items.kevAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
